text: for grandson. I got these so my 3 year old grandson could participate when we are all using chopsticks. With these he gets the general idea.  The monkey top does come off, however this makes it easier to clean the chopsticks in my mind.  (My husband who is NOT so chopstick inclined uses them when my grandson is not around haha)

description: Genuine Fred Chimpstick is chopsticks and a chopstick holder in a monkey shape. Great for children to learn chopstick use or for adults who are chopstick impared. Warning Choking Hazard! Contains small parts, not for children under 3.
